info.name: VelUI Google
info.description:
一個Google搜索大修，修改了主頁和結果頁面。和大多數主題不同，這不是單純的改變一個背景而已，而是包括了背景、樣式，甚至是佈局的全面修改。

A overhaul of Google Search has modified the homepage and results pages. Unlike most themes, this isn't just a simple change of background, but a comprehensive modification encompassing the background, style, and even layout.
